data.name: ThinkCentre X Ultra — 128GB / 96GB GPU allocation (pre-release)

source.label: User-provided pre-final ThinkCentre X Ultra datasheet with PM corrections; AMD processor specification

runtimeSupport.notes: The source lists operating-system options but does not provide a model-bound LLM runtime validation. Verify the final image, runtime and model build.

data.notes: Pre-final configuration, not a quoteable final specification. Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495; onboard LPDDR5X up to 128GB; the source describes up to 96GB graphics allocation, modeled here as allocatable unified memory rather than dedicated VRAM. Approx. 273 GB/s is a theoretical value derived from AMD's 256-bit LPDDR5X-8533 specification, not a measured system result. The separate NPU is rated up to 55 TOPS; TOPS is not converted to LLM TPS. PM corrections: front USB-C charging is 5V@3A; rear ports are described as 2x Thunderbolt 4 (40Gbps); the model claim is Qwen3.5-235B-A22B (Q2) and is not treated as a benchmark. The 245W PSU rating is not used as system load power. Price, idle/load power, TPS and TTFT are unavailable.

data.notes: Pre-release Tech Ready configuration: ready for system design, with validation/certification and GEO configuration availability still pending per the supplied slide. The supplied TCX 34L Thermal Matrix gives 603W calculated power for the U9/U7 configuration used here (526W with U5) and a 1200W T3/PSU rule; this is a design calculation, not measured wall power. X Tower is a 34L platform with up to 256GB DDR5-5600 and several listed Intel Core Ultra CPU options. Whole-system price, idle power, TPS and TTFT are unavailable.
